sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is structurally valid and semantically faithful: alternative evidence is optional, and when qualifying calculation or model-test evidence is present, it conditionally requires approved status, an approved non-revoked state, and at least one correctly typed Ke or RCH result on the ship. The Ke/RCH alternatives, evidence alternatives, owner, datatypes, and units are preserved without requiring omitted performance-experience evidence.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The graph is structurally valid but not semantically faithful: it makes every targeted ship have an approved alternative Ke/RCH determination and evidence, although the requirement applies only when the alternative method is used and approval is obtained. Encode applicability conditionally without inventing a universal mandatory alternative. Also ensure the approval/revocation boundary is represented consistently: approvalStatus true must correspond to the approved alternative, while approvalRevocationStatus must not be an unconstrained arbitrary evidenceState that permits a revoked alternative to pass. Preserve the ship owner and the Ke-versus-RCH and calculation-evidence-versus-model-test alternatives.

Revise the applicability logic: the requirement is optional and applies only when an alternative calculation or model-test method is used. The current SPARQL FILTER rejects every ship lacking alternative evidence, making the alternative universally mandatory. Permit the no-alternative case, and conditionally require the selected alternative evidence, approvalStatus true, approvalRevocationStatus evidenceStateApproved, and at least one Ke or RCH result only when alternative evidence is present. Preserve the Ke/RCH and calculation/model-test alternatives and ensure revoked status cannot satisfy the active approval branch. This is a semantic/SHACL repair using already supplied canonical terms, so do not activate the matcher.

The candidate is structurally valid and semantically faithful: alternative evidence is optional, and when qualifying calculation or model-test evidence is present, it conditionally requires approved status, an approved non-revoked state, and at least one correctly typed Ke or RCH result on the ship. The Ke/RCH alternatives, evidence alternatives, owner, datatypes, and units are preserved without requiring omitted performance-experience evidence.
